hypotheses.justification: The integral need not be evaluated using the totally-complex formula: integrating each place separately gives a constant times the product of the embedding factors |w(x)|^{-2 s.re}. On the fundamental cone, the normalized embedding coordinates are uniformly comparable, so this product is bounded by a constant times |Norm(x)|^{-α}, where α = 2 s.re (r₁+r₂)/[K:ℚ] ≥ s.re > 1. The resulting series is controlled by `summable_idealSet_inverseNormPower` at exponent α. This also covers fields with real places; ideal-set elements are nonzero, so no zero-value exception arises.
